attr.title: UltraCombo (KillerArm)
attr.desc: ARM64 / OpenGL ES 2.0 handheld port of UltraCombo (static recompilation engine for Killer Instinct and Killer Instinct 2 arcade boards), tuned for Anbernic RG34XX (Allwinner H700) and compatible AArch64 PortMaster devices. Bring your own MAME ROMs and CHDs.
attr.inst: Copy your own legal MAME ROMs and CHD/raw disk images for kinst and/or kinst2 into ports/ultracombo/run/. For locked 60 FPS on Allwinner H700 (Anbernic RG34XX / RG35XX / RG40XX), pre-build the -O2 Cortex-A53 cache module on a PC using tools/build-arm64-cache.sh and copy cache/ into ports/ultracombo/cache/. Without a pre-built cache, TinyCC builds an in-memory fallback on-device.
